req.title: Cookies-set returns Set-Cookie per entry
req.statement: The system shall emit one Set-Cookie header per k=v pair passed to /cookies/set.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /cookies/set must emit one Set-Cookie header per k=v pair. The set_cookies() handler iterates request.args and calls r.set_cookie() for each pair, then redirects. Tests must verify: (1) positive — two query params produce exactly two Set-Cookie headers; (2) negative — zero query params produce zero Set-Cookie headers; (3) boundary — exactly one query param produces exactly one Set-Cookie header (BVA at n=1). Additional tests cover exact cookie name/value content, the redirect status code (302), and the redirect target to kill constant/comparison mutations.

tests.name: test_cookies_set_two_params_emits_two_set_cookie_headers
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
No pre-existing cookies on the test client
actions: Create a fresh test client with follow_redirects=False
expected: Exactly two Set-Cookie headers present in the response
trace: R-HTTPBIN-047: one Set-Cookie per k=v pair
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_cookies_set_two_params_emits_two_set_cookie_headers():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/cookies/set?a=1&b=2', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    set_cookie_headers = r.headers.getlist('Set-Cookie')
    assert len(set_cookie_headers) == 2
    joined = ' '.join(set_cookie_headers)
    assert 'a=1' in joined
    assert 'b=2' in joined

test_cookies_set_two_params_emits_two_set_cookie_headers()

tests.name: test_cookies_set_cookie_values_are_exact
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Create a fresh test client with follow_redirects=True
Follow redirect to /cookies and inspect JSON body
expected: JSON body cookies dict contains exactly foo=bar and baz=qux
No extra cookies beyond foo and baz
trace: R-HTTPBIN-047: cookie name and value fidelity after redirect
DT: both name and value columns must match exactly
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_cookies_set_cookie_values_are_exact():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/cookies/set?foo=bar&baz=qux', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = json.loads(r.data.decode('utf-8'))
    cookies = body.get('cookies')
    assert cookies is not None
    assert cookies.get('foo') == 'bar'
    assert cookies.get('baz') == 'qux'
    assert len(cookies) == 2

test_cookies_set_cookie_values_are_exact()
